leastWorthwhile.text: Putting the prepared protein builder inside was clear but felt mostly like following the newly revealed placement goal.

surprise.text: I was interested that the same ATP supply supports both protein building and the pump, which moves particles toward the more crowded side.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and goals made the pairings understandable, even when the detailed mechanisms were not explained.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: seeing the cell's parts come together made me curious how the game would build up to tissues and organs.
